title: UI Library Part 1 — Button, IconButton, Input, TextArea, Select, Checkbox
description: Create the first batch of reusable UI primitives in src/renderer/src/ui-library/. Each component uses Tailwind v4 utility classes with dark: variants for automatic light/dark theming. Components should be composable, accessible, and follow React patterns with TypeScript interfaces for props. Create the barrel index.ts for re-exports.
acceptance_criteria: Button component with variant (primary, secondary, ghost, danger), size (sm, md, lg), disabled state
IconButton component wrapping Button with icon-only layout
Input component with label, placeholder, error state, disabled state
TextArea component with label, placeholder, resize control, error state
Select component with options array, placeholder, disabled state
Checkbox component with label, checked/indeterminate state
All components use Tailwind v4 classes with dark: variants
All components have TypeScript prop interfaces
